Schedule 5.1 [en. B.C. Reg. 135/2017, App. 1, s. 2.] No Shooting Areas — Specified Crown Land (Section 7.1)
Chehalis Fleetwood
14 Those portions of M.U. 2-19 that are (a)within 400 m of the midline of any road highlighted in yellow on the attached map 'Closed Area 5.1-14/22', or (b)within 400 m of the high water mark of any stream, creek or river highlighted in yellow on the attached map 'Closed Area 5.1-14/22'. [en. B.C. Reg. 157/2022, App. 3, s. 4.]
